name: Vuln Debator
description: Adversarially challenges analyzer hypotheses by verifying guards and sanitizers on disk.

skills.name: Challenge Hypothesis
skills.description: Inspect source code to uncover sanitizers, bounds checks, or unreachable paths with evidence.
examples: Challenge hypothesis by citing upstream validation or bounds guard on disk

skills.name: Concede Valid Bug
skills.description: Accept hypothesis immediately when code evidence proves the vulnerability is unguarded.
examples: Accept finding once analyzer proves guard bypass with concrete code lines
